change_summary: The paper has been withdrawn, and its record is now titled as withdrawn. The withdrawal is because the indoor temperature records were processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, so the results cannot be relied on, and the full text was replaced by the statement. The stored paper's main results, such as the 2.1 °C lower daily peak in green-roofed flats, rest on those records, so the whole paper's findings are affected.
evaluation: Your Methods (2.2) sets the green-roof indoor cooling effect to 2.1 °C, citing Okafor et al. [14], and your Discussion says the green-roof result scales almost directly with that value. The stored paper's 2.1 °C figure comes from indoor temperature records that the withdrawal says were processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, so its results cannot be relied on. Both the Methods and Discussion uses are therefore touched. The impact on your draft is high, because your key parameter and main result depend on this value.
recommendation: The paper has been withdrawn because its indoor temperature records were processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, so its results cannot be relied on. Your Methods (2.2) and Discussion both take the 2.1 °C green-roof cooling effect from Okafor et al. [14], so both uses are touched. Raise this with your co-authors or supervisor before changing the text, because your model parameter depends on it. Then replace the citation and re-check the green-roof result and its conclusions.
